name: Turbopack
one_liner: Rust-based incremental bundler, primarily a Next.js concern for now.
what_it_is: An incremental bundler written in Rust, designed around caching work at function-call granularity so that rebuilds do the minimum possible. It is developed alongside and mainly consumed through Next.js.
why_it_matters: Worth tracking rather than adopting independently. Its relevance today is almost entirely determined by whether you use Next.js; outside that, Vite remains the sensible default. Listed as emerging because its story outside its parent framework is not yet established.
suitable_for: Next.js projects on versions where it is the supported default
Very large codebases where incremental rebuild cost dominates
not_suitable_for: Projects outside the Next.js ecosystem today
Teams that need a stable, broadly documented plugin surface
